_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/costs/test_opponent_activated_ability.py. Never part of a deck list. `t_oft_nabbed_goat` is Oft-Nabbed Goat as printed; `t_town_well` is an any-player ability, the sibling wording ("Any player may activate this ability").

cards.name: Test Oft-Nabbed Goat
cards.oracle_text:
{1}: Draw a card. Gain control of this creature and put a -1/-1 counter on it. Only your opponents may activate this ability and only as a sorcery.
When this creature dies, if it had one or more -1/-1 counters on it, its owner draws that many cards and each other player loses that much life.
